name: router-default
instructions: Which route should handle the latest user message?

criteria.casual: a standalone greeting, thanks, goodbye, or light social chat that needs no facts, memory, or action
criteria.deviceAction: a request to do one thing on this device (timer, alarm, reminder, calendar, message, call)
criteria.assistant: anything else: questions, advice, requests that need facts, tools, or earlier messages, or a greeting combined with a request

criteria.casual: small talk only: a greeting, thanks, goodbye, 'how are you', or an acknowledgement; no information or action is wanted
criteria.deviceAction: a command to create or change something on this phone: start a timer, set an alarm, add a reminder or calendar event, send a text, place a call
criteria.assistant: wants information or work: a question, a lookup (weather, calendar contents, email, health, prices), writing, planning, remembering, or small talk combined with a request

name: what-does-user-want
instructions: What does the user want from the assistant?

criteria.casual: just a friendly reply; they are chatting, greeting, thanking or signing off
criteria.deviceAction: perform one phone action now (timer, alarm, reminder, calendar event, text, call)
criteria.assistant: an answer, information, content, or help that needs knowledge, tools, data or earlier context
